proposed_held_at_use_mapping_review_not_.why: The narrow holding claim can be supported by target/EEF sustained actual motion; demanding a separate positive contact surface certificate for both fingers would add a new, unnecessary observation requirement to this scoped predicate.
proposed_held_at_use_mapping_review_not_.negative_requires: Independent actual relative separation/loss-of-carrying at the exact use deadline, with retained entity identities and sufficient RGB witnesses; a certified release may support holding-negative only under a separately audited mapping.

proposed_held_at_use_mapping_review_not_.entry_time_limit: A future carrying prediction cannot repair deadline 0. Reliable current observation can reestablish current belief separately; candidate prefix certificates can supervise only later planned use times.

limits: These synthetic tests establish source/path/score-interface wiring, not a trained model, label admission, real selection improvement or closed-loop efficacy.

The factory deliberately credits only a current-block TRUE-to-invalid change with positive old confidence. Cross-block existing deficits require independently preserved before-provenance; they are not reconstructed from rewritten sources.

If multiple factors sequentially invalidate the same fact in one block, later changes may see old UNKNOWN and receive no new credit. This conservatively avoids duplicate deficit claims but can under-credit later causes; a future multi-cause extension must preserve the original before fact instead of relaxing the UNKNOWN guard.

Existing coarse stage timing is inherited unchanged. Each enabled predicate still needs an independently audited meaning at the actual use time. OBSERVE/UNCERTAIN currently have no declared candidate prerequisites; this bridge alone does not make a reobservation scorer.

A typed dataclass or allowlisted name is not a full audit of every upstream X source. Existing before/predicted producer provenance restrictions and the old 604-source independent-certification limitation remain.
